title: Concealed Chinese text displayed incorrectly.
body: - `nvim --version`: ``` $ LANG="en_GB.UTF-8" nvim --version NVIM v0.5.0-dev+1263-ga129887c0 Build type: RelWithDebInfo LuaJIT 2.1.0-beta3 Compilation: /usr/bin/cc -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=1 -O2 -g -Og -g -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Wno-unused-parameter -Wstrict-prototypes -std=gnu99 -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wmissing-prototypes -Wvla -fstack-protector-strong -fno-common -fdiagnostics-color=always -DINCLUDE_GENERATED_DECLARATIONS -D_GNU_SOURCE -DNVIM_MSGPACK_HAS_FLOAT32 -DNVIM_UNIBI_HAS_VAR_FROM -DMIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 -I/home/runner/work/neovim/neovim/build/config -I/home/runner/work/neovim/neovim/src -I/home/runner/work/neovim/neovim/.deps/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/home/runner/work/neovim/neovim/build/src/nvim/auto -I/home/runner/work/neovim/neovim/build/include Compiled by runner@fv-az36-146 Features: +acl +iconv +tui See ":help feature-compile" system vimrc file: "$VIM/sysinit.vim" fall-back for $VIM: "/share/nvim" Run :checkhealth for more info ``` - Operating system/version: Arch Linux x86_64 - Terminal name/version: Tilix ``` LANG="en_GB.UTF-8" tilix --version Versions Tilix version: 1.9.4 VTE version: 0.64 GTK Version: 3.24.29 Tilix Special Features Notifications enabled=0 Triggers enabled=0 Badges enabled=1 ``` - `$TERM`: xterm-256color Vim behaves the same. ### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC` ``` nvim -u NORC :0r 人类发育与遗传学.md :syn region HWHtmlLink matchgroup=HWHtmlLinkDelimiter start='' end='' concealends :set conceallevel=2 ``` The Content of `人类发育与遗传学.md`(`xclip -selection clipboard < 人类发育与遗传学.md`): ``` 1. 人类发育的细胞学和遗传学基础 2. 配子的发生与受精 3. 早期胚胎发育 1. aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa 2. aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa 3. aaaaaaaaaaaa ``` ![display_error](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36324537/119664593-13057b00-be66-11eb-8d77-d07698900560.png) ### Actual behaviour Please see this [video](https://vimeo.com/716402593). ### Expected behaviour The text is expected to display properly. ### Related issues I found issue #9360 that describes a similar problem and it seems to be thought solved [here](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/9368#issue-238900009).
